purpose: Compact permanent memory for Black Paint Studio execution and scene-aware fidelity.

identity.hair: black, very long, dense mass first, 3-7 major fringe locks, no comb-like stripe field
identity.horns: exactly two by default, upper-lateral roots, outward then upward curve, thick base, tapered tip, visually attached to skull/hairline
identity.face: elegant anime adult proportions, tapered jaw, soft chin, expressive eyes, minimal nose, small mouth
identity.outfit: black gothic garment, choker anchor, curved torso silhouette, neckline plus sparse lace/strap/jewel details
identity.monochrome: face remains mostly light; hair/horns/outfit are dominant black masses with sparse gray separation

execution.advance_rule: do not advance past failed validation; repair current stage first
execution.paint_program: use BLACKCORE_MISUKI_PAINT_PROGRAM v4; it contains small executable operations, normalized coordinates, tools, widths, dependencies and retry behavior
execution.checkpoint_policy: hard-stop current build stage on structural failure; emit partial diagnostic and retry current stage before later stages

scene_rules.core: scene supports the character; it must never compete with the face
scene_rules.focus: highest local contrast belongs to face/eyes; props live mainly on side thirds
scene_rules.lighting: one dominant lighting direction; use rim/backlight to separate black hair and horns
scene_rules.safe_zone: reduce detail and contrast behind the upper face/horns

negative_rules: no roof or pentagon hair top
no comb-like field of parallel hair lines
no outfit made from horizontal placeholder bars
no busy high-contrast background behind face
no false 98-100 identity score from contrast/symmetry alone

score_policy.technical_score: global raster quality only; never identity fidelity
score_policy.structural_fidelity: geometry/pixel proxy; capped at 90 until a true reference-aware vision model exists
score_policy.scene_quality: composition proxy based on depth, safe-zone, lighting coherence and focal hierarchy
